- tests/test_audit_consumer_drift.py:1766 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new pin-age alarm tests are not listed in the file main() function.
  WHY: The direct python3 run in CI at ci.yml line 696 would skip these tests and lose regression protection (source severity MAJOR); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 (main() at lines 1831-1854) and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash (main() at tests/test_audit_consumer_drift.py:1828-1856) rejected this as stale and say main() calls every pin-age test, including the two run through _DirectRunEnvPatch.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:~2576 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The verify_head_gate poll window (6 reads, 20 seconds apart) can run out while workflow-integrity is still pending.
  WHY: The step exits 0 without posting ai-review/head-gate=success, so the PR stays pending in review and someone must step in by hand (source severity NIT); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash call this a NIT accepted in earlier rounds and note that an expired poll window now raises a ::warning::.
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:106-183 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The updater-PR exemption in review_head_gate_updater_exempt uses a hard-coded regex, REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_BRANCH_RE, and an integrity context string that duplicate values defined in other workflow files.
  WHY: A later change to the updater branch format or the integrity context could break the exemption or the gating without warning, and nothing automated would catch it (source severity NIT); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash call this a residual NIT accepted in earlier rounds.
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:160 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The head-gate exemption trusts commit statuses without checking who created them.
  WHY: Anyone with push access and statuses: write can already post the gate directly, so this is accepted residual risk, but it adds an implicit trust boundary to the review process (source severity NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
